description: Get the user's saved legal profile (their Impressum details: name/company, address, contact, and for a company the representative, register and VAT id). Read this BEFORE asking the user for Impressum data, so you reuse what they already gave and only ask for what is missing. Returns the profile (or null) and imprintReady = whether it has the §5 DDG minimum.
name: runzero_get_legal_profile
title: Get legal profile
